reasoning_content:
The frontend config is correct and keycloak.init with onLoad:'login-required' will redirect to Keycloak. We can simulate login: use the auth flow via curl? It's a browser redirect. But we can at least verify the authorization endpoint accepts the client and redirect URL by doing an auth request and confirming it returns a login page / 302 to login-actions. Let's do that.

curl the authorization URL with redirect_uri=http://localhost:4200/* and client_id=strassennamen, response_type=code, scope=openid. Check status.

action.command:
echo "=== Authorization endpoint for frontend redirect ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=strassennamen&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A4200%2F*&response_type=code&scope=openid&state=abc"
echo "=== full login flow (form) ==="; curl -s -c /tmp/kc.jar -b /tmp/kc.jar -L "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=strassennamen&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A4200%2F*&response_type=code&scope=openid" -o /tmp/login.html -w "final HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n"; grep -o 'name="[^"]*"' /tmp/login.html | sort -u | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== Authorization endpoint for frontend redirect ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\\n\" \"http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=strassennamen&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A4200%2F*&response_type=code&scope=openid&state=abc\"\necho \"=== full login flow (form) ===\"; curl -s -c /tmp/kc.jar -b /tmp/kc.jar -L \"http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=strassennamen&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A4200%2F*&response_type=code&scope=openid\" -o /tmp/login.html -w \"final HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\\n\"; grep -o 'name=\"[^\"]*\"' /tmp/login.html | sort -u | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify keycloak login redirect flow"}
